verse.verse_2: There is no denying that it will befall -
verse.verse_4: When the earth is shaken with a shock
verse.verse_5: And the hills are ground to powder
verse.verse_6: So that they become a scattered dust,
verse.verse_7: And ye will be three kinds:
verse.verse_8: (First) those on the right hand; what of those on the right hand?
verse.verse_9: And (then) those on the left hand; what of those on the left hand?
verse.verse_10: And the foremost in the race, the foremost in the race:
verse.verse_11: Those are they who will be brought nigh
verse.verse_13: A multitude of those of old
verse.verse_14: And a few of those of later time.
verse.verse_17: There wait on them immortal youths
verse.verse_18: With bowls and ewers and a cup from a pure spring
verse.verse_19: Wherefrom they get no aching of the head nor any madness,
verse.verse_21: And flesh of fowls that they desire.
verse.verse_22: And (there are) fair ones with wide, lovely eyes,
verse.verse_24: Reward for what they used to do.
verse.verse_25: There hear they no vain speaking nor recrimination
verse.verse_26: (Naught) but the saying: Peace, (and again) Peace.
verse.verse_27: And those on the right hand; what of those on the right hand?
verse.verse_33: Neither out of reach nor yet forbidden,
verse.verse_35: Lo! We have created them a (new) creation
verse.verse_38: For those on the right hand;
verse.verse_39: A multitude of those of old
verse.verse_40: And a multitude of those of later time.
verse.verse_41: And those on the left hand: What of those on the left hand?
verse.verse_42: In scorching wind and scalding water
verse.verse_45: Lo! heretofore they were effete with luxury
verse.verse_46: And used to persist in the awful sin.
verse.verse_47: And they used to say: When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised again,
verse.verse_49: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Lo! those of old and those of later time
verse.verse_50: Will all be brought together to the tryst of an appointed day.
verse.verse_51: Then lo! ye, the erring, the deniers,
verse.verse_52: Ye verily will eat of a tree called Zaqqum
verse.verse_53: And will fill your bellies therewith;
verse.verse_54: And thereon ye will drink of boiling water,
verse.verse_55: Drinking even as the camel drinketh.
verse.verse_56: This will be their welcome on the Day of Judgment.
verse.verse_57: We created you. Will ye then admit the truth?
verse.verse_58: Have ye seen that which ye emit?
verse.verse_59: Do ye create it or are We the Creator?
verse.verse_60: We mete out death among you, and We are not to be outrun,
verse.verse_61: That We may transfigure you and make you what ye know not.
verse.verse_62: And verily ye know the first creation. Why, then, do ye not reflect?
verse.verse_63: Have ye seen that which ye cultivate?
verse.verse_64: Is it ye who foster it, or are We the Fosterer?
verse.verse_65: If We willed, We verily could make it chaff, then would ye cease not to exclaim:
verse.verse_66: Lo! we are laden with debt!
verse.verse_68: Have ye observed the water which ye drink?
verse.verse_69: Is it ye who shed it from the raincloud, or are We the Shedder?
verse.verse_70: If We willed We verily could make it bitter. Why then, give ye not thanks?
verse.verse_71: Have ye observed the fire which ye strike out;
verse.verse_72: Was it ye who made the tree thereof to grow, or were We the grower?
verse.verse_73: We, even We, appointed it a memorial and a comfort for the dwellers in the wilderness.
verse.verse_74: Therefor (O Muhammad), praise the name of thy Lord, the Tremendous.
verse.verse_75: Nay, I swear by the places of the stars -
verse.verse_76: And lo! that verily is a tremendous oath, if ye but knew -
verse.verse_77: That (this) is indeed a noble Qur'an
verse.verse_79: Which none toucheth save the purified,
verse.verse_80: A revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.
verse.verse_81: Is it this Statement that ye scorn,
verse.verse_82: And make denial thereof your livelihood?
verse.verse_83: Why, then, when (the soul) cometh up to the throat (of the dying)
verse.verse_84: And ye are at that moment looking
verse.verse_85: - And We are nearer unto him than ye are, but ye see not -
verse.verse_86: Why then, if ye are not in bondage (unto Us),
verse.verse_87: Do ye not force it back, if ye are truthful?
verse.verse_88: Thus if he is of those brought nigh,
verse.verse_89: Then breath of life, and plenty, and a Garden of delight.
verse.verse_90: And if he is of those on the right hand,
verse.verse_91: Then (the greeting) "Peace be unto thee" from those on the right hand.
verse.verse_92: But if he is of the rejecters, the erring,
verse.verse_93: Then the welcome will be boiling water
verse.verse_96: Therefor (O Muhammad) praise the name of thy Lord, the Tremendous.
